scientific_integrity: The analytic argument, not finite-dimensional numerical tests, proves the dimension-uniform theorem. The primary source first appeared publicly 2014-10-06. Self-review is not independent expert validation; priority is subject to residual literature risk.
scientific_limitations: Independent pure single-photon sources, exactly one photon per N input and output spatial modes, ideal internal-state-insensitive detectors and N-by-N unitary optical network. Requires internal span dimension >= N-1. Quantitative bound additionally assumes full-support unique dependence; no claim for lower rank, other output patterns, mixed or entangled inputs, imperfect channels, or optimality of the lower bound.
title: A codimension-one barrier to complete photon-coincidence suppression
